features.title: A guide whenever you need it
features.description: The screenshot tutorial opens on startup until you choose “Skip this tutorial next time”. Closing it or finishing a walkthrough only dismisses it for this session.

features.title: See what changed after an update
features.description: Key features appear once for each release. Choose “Got it” to acknowledge this version; the next release gets its own introduction.

features.title: Everything stays local
features.description: These preferences and release highlights work offline. You can always reopen the tutorial from Guide or F1, and turn startup guidance back on there.
